item.title: ALIVE! Vinyl Record LP, Urana Records 1979
item.description: Vintage 1979 vinyl LP album titled "ALIVE!" released on Urana Records (Wise Women Enterprises). Two-sided record featuring music produced by Alfred Woltes with recording and mixing by Alfred and Attred Woltes. Album includes tracks such as "Somebody's Talkin' to You," "Rhiannon," "Part of Me/Changes," and "Spirit Healer." Cover features black and white photograph of five women laughing together. Record and sleeve show signs of age with light wear; vinyl appears playable.
